g.text: Cache-condition comparison: absolute deltas and observed variation
Historical C4 study, not the 2048-candidate capacity experiment. Min-max is not a confidence interval.
Internal zero-cache output lengths differ across runs; the normal-cache condition has no repeat distribution.
